changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: UPDATE catalog_items ci JOIN ( SELECT 'CORE' AS code, 'Clientes y mascotas' AS name UNION ALL SELECT 'LAB_IMAGING', 'Laboratorio y radiografías' UNION ALL SELECT 'SERVICES', 'Tarifas y promociones' UNION ALL SELECT 'CASH_REGISTER', 'Caja y ventas' UNION ALL SELECT 'INVENTORY', 'Inventario de productos' UNION ALL SELECT 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS', 'Cuentas por cobrar' ) seed ON seed.code = ci.code SET ci.name = seed.name, ci.version = ci.version + 1

rollback.sql: UPDATE catalog_items ci JOIN ( SELECT 'CORE' AS code, 'Núcleo: clientes y mascotas' AS name UNION ALL SELECT 'LAB_IMAGING', 'Laboratorio e imagen diagnóstica' UNION ALL SELECT 'SERVICES', 'Servicios, tarifas y promociones' UNION ALL SELECT 'CASH_REGISTER', 'Caja y punto de venta' UNION ALL SELECT 'INVENTORY', 'Inventario y kardex' UNION ALL SELECT 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS', 'Cuentas abiertas y cartera' ) seed ON seed.code = ci.code SET ci.name = seed.name, ci.version = ci.version + 1
